related.title: Dunant：空間分割多工容量取捨
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學單向傳播預算35 ms；6000 km通過、7200 km不通過；低於模型下限的報告先查單位與量測方向。 marea_latency.csv與單向/往返延遲分解圖 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 30 與變更 36 ms、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching one-way propagation budget35 ms:6000 km passes and7200 km fails; a measurement below the model floor requires unit and direction checks. marea_latency.csv and one-way/round-trip delay decomposition Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 30 and changed 36 ms, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學單方向需求220 Tbit/s；A通過、B不足；仍需單獨查海纜電力與放大器設計。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching one-direction demand220 Tbit/s:A passes andB falls short; cable power and amplifier feasibility remain separate checks.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以MAREA為案例背景；合成纖長6000 km、群速度2e8 m/s，繞路後7200 km；均非其公布實測。 名義式 6000*1000/2e8*1000 = 30 ms；變更式 7200*1000/2e8*1000 = 36 ms。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 以每公里5 µs獨立換算；理想對稱往返分別60與72 ms，再把已知終端延遲另列。
合成方案A為12對纖、每方向每纖20 Tbit/s；方案B為8對、每纖25 Tbit/s，均以單方向計。 名義式 12*20 = 240 Tbit/s；變更式 8*25 = 200 Tbit/s。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 逐纖建立清單相加，再檢查雙向總量若需報告應另乘2；不得同時計纖對與雙向而重複加倍。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: MAREA motivates a synthetic6000 km fiber route at2e8 m/s, changed to7200 km; neither is a published measurement of the system. Nominal 6000*1000/2e8*1000 = 30 ms; changed 7200*1000/2e8*1000 = 36 ms. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Independently use5 microseconds per kilometer; ideal symmetric round trips are60 and72 ms before separately listed terminal delay.

Synthetic planA uses12 fiber pairs at20 Tbit/s per fiber per direction; planB uses8 pairs at25 Tbit/s, consistently counting one direction. Nominal 12*20 = 240 Tbit/s; changed 8*25 = 200 Tbit/s. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Sum a per-fiber inventory; multiply by two separately only for a bidirectional report, avoiding double-counting pairs and directions.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: BB84：二元熵與漸近祕密比例
related.titleEn: BB84: binary entropy and asymptotic secret fraction
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學單向傳播預算35 ms；6000 km通過、7200 km不通過；低於模型下限的報告先查單位與量測方向。 marea_latency.csv與單向/往返延遲分解圖 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 30 與變更 36 ms、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching one-way propagation budget35 ms:6000 km passes and7200 km fails; a measurement below the model floor requires unit and direction checks. marea_latency.csv and one-way/round-trip delay decomposition Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 30 and changed 36 ms, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學漸近比例門檻0.5；2%通過、8%不足；任何可用祕密率報告另須乘偵測/篩選速率並扣有限長度代價。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching asymptotic-fraction target0.5:2% passes and8% fails; usable key rates additionally require detection/sifting rates and finite-size costs.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以MAREA為案例背景；合成纖長6000 km、群速度2e8 m/s，繞路後7200 km；均非其公布實測。 名義式 6000*1000/2e8*1000 = 30 ms；變更式 7200*1000/2e8*1000 = 36 ms。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 以每公里5 µs獨立換算；理想對稱往返分別60與72 ms，再把已知終端延遲另列。

合成QBER Q=0.02，擾動Q=0.08；h2(Q)=−Qlog2Q−(1−Q)log2(1−Q)，結果每篩選位元計。 名義式 max(0,1+2*(0.02*log2(0.02)+0.98*log2(0.98))) = 0.717119 secret fraction；變更式 max(0,1+2*(0.08*log2(0.08)+0.92*log2(0.92))) = 0.195642 secret fraction。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 以四個等價機率項手算熵，再檢查Q趨近0時比例趨近1；Q=0.5時裁切到0，不容許負金鑰長度。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: MAREA motivates a synthetic6000 km fiber route at2e8 m/s, changed to7200 km; neither is a published measurement of the system. Nominal 6000*1000/2e8*1000 = 30 ms; changed 7200*1000/2e8*1000 = 36 ms. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Independently use5 microseconds per kilometer; ideal symmetric round trips are60 and72 ms before separately listed terminal delay.

SyntheticQBER0.02 changed to0.08; use binary entropy and report per sifted bit. Nominal max(0,1+2*(0.02*log2(0.02)+0.98*log2(0.98))) = 0.717119 secret fraction; changed max(0,1+2*(0.08*log2(0.08)+0.92*log2(0.92))) = 0.195642 secret fraction. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Independently tabulate entropy contributions and check the limit approachingQ=0 gives one; atQ=0.5 clip to zero rather than negative key length.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
